changed.headline: Because of AI, neurosurgery outpatients in Dresden who were given an AI-written plain-language summary of their own findings before the visit rated the conversation with their doctor higher, and the consultation was shorter (median 25 vs 33 minutes).
Clinicians at Columbia who adopted Epic's AI-drafted replies to patient messages answered 8.6% more slowly afterwards, and their after-hours replying did not fall, across 983,154 responses.

Because of AI, outpatient clinicians in a 14-hospital Boston health system who enrolled in the Heidi ambient scribe spent 1.21 minutes less on each note, though their after-hours note work did not change.

An AI-ECG screen of 14,665 adults at a Taiwanese hospital did not significantly increase atrial fibrillation diagnoses (0.3% vs 0.2%) or the start of antiarrhythmic treatment, compared with usual care.

Because of AI, in-hospital deaths among high-risk ward patients fell from 23.1% to 18.6% after 11 hospitals let a deterioration model page the rapid response team automatically (adjusted odds ratio 0.82).

Sending Pakistan's mobile TB X-ray camps to sites picked by AI did not find significantly more tuberculosis per camp than sites picked by field staff, across 3,936 camps and 269,254 people screened, in the trial's primary analysis.
Because of AI, the Hurricane Center called a Category 5 landfall in Jamaica about three days out, while Melissa was still a Category 1.

leads_added: Obstetric point-of-care AI ultrasound in routine antenatal care, Lusaka Province, Zambia. [Int J Gynaecol Obstet](https://doi.org/10.1002/ijgo.71476) (2026-11-09). Real deployment with pregnant women; `npm run read` returns HTTP 403. Missing: full text, design, comparison, dates, absolute effects.

Explainable AI for diabetic foot ulcer prognosis, derivation and validation with a prospective randomised component. [EClinicalMedicine](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eclinm.2026.104284) (2026-10-31). `npm run read` returns an 11-character stub. Missing: abstract, what the randomised part compared, patient outcomes, dates.

ARIA holographic AI concierge in an ambulatory lobby, Mayo Clinic. [Mayo Clin Proc Digit Health](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mcpdig.2026.100427) (PMC13744326). Read in full: single-site descriptive pilot, 2025-10-21 to 2026-02-02, 1429 sessions, no comparison and no outcome. Not an entry; revisit if a prospective evaluation appears.
Protocol to watch: ROMIAE-2 AI-ECG rule-out of myocardial infarction, noninferiority RCT ([Clin Exp Emerg Med](https://doi.org/10.15441/ceem.26.305)). AEARCTR-0019968 was already logged 2026-11-07.
Still open: LATENT (Circulation, unreadable), as logged 2026-11-08.
Skipped: reviews, editorials, retrospective validations, benchmarks, AI-for-science news, ERIC items already seen, EdArXiv items without field outcomes.

Sustaining AI-Enabled Student Support: four-year RCT of an AI text-messaging chatbot at a large urban public university (EdWorkingPaper 26-1409, July 2026). [EdWorkingPapers](https://edworkingpapers.com/ai26-1409). The abstract reports better completion of time-sensitive administrative tasks and "no detectable effects on academic performance or persistence", so it is a possible `not-because` or mixed entry. Missing: the PDF read through the gate's reader (pdftotext was unavailable to this run), effect sizes, cohort years.

NUMI, Making AI Tutoring Productive (carried over). [NBER w35621](https://www.nber.org/papers/w35621). Unread this run because the PDF needs pdftotext, which this session lacked. Missing: the editorial call on a pooled AI-vs-no-AI estimate (see 2026-10-27).

AI for Proactive Mental Health, Flourish app RCT, 486 students at three US institutions, fall 2024. [NEJM AI](https://doi.org/10.1056/AIoa2501293). The abstract reports gains in resilience and social well-being and no effect on depression, anxiety or stress, but no effect sizes. Pre-window. Context for `flourish-ai-coach-students-rct`. Missing: full text (403), effect sizes.

DEEP-AF, AI-ECG for AF in symptomatic patients, multicentre RCT, Korea. [Heart Rhythm O2 design paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.hroo.2026.07.009) (PMC13700359). A design paper with no results; watch for results.

AI-assisted micro-TESE (carried over). [Asian J Androl](https://doi.org/10.4103/aja202644). Read in full and rejected this run: allocation was by availability of the AI microscope over 2020 to 2024 with no timing given, and inclusion criterion 5 contradicts the reported retrieval rate. Revisit only if a prospective or randomized study appears.

AI-facilitated nutrition guidance after GI cancer surgery (carried over). [Support Care Cancer](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00520-026-11401-7). Rejected again: besides the Methods/Results date conflict, the paper was received 29 Mar 2026, which rules out the Methods window (screening to March 2026 plus 30-day follow-up). Revisit if a correction gives one enrolment window.
Bihar flood early warnings (carried over). [PreventionWeb](https://www.preventionweb.net/quick/96851) still returns HTTP 403 to the reader. Missing: the underlying evaluation.
